chapters.about: The background of Korah and his rebellion against Moshe

chapters.title: The Dangers of Jealousy

chapters.about: Comparing the influence of wives in the stories of Korah and On ben Pelet

summary: Rabbi Besser discusses the nature of agendas and divine decrees by examining narratives from Parashat Korah and Parashat Hukat. He explores how personal motivations and jealousy can cloud one's judgment, contrasting these with the necessity of adhering to the laws of Hashem. The class emphasizes the importance of relying on Torah guidance rather than personal logic or societal pressure when making difficult life decisions.
subjects: The story of Korah and his rebellion
The role of the wife in the story of On ben Pelet
The authority of the Torah in decision-making
questions: How can jealousy influence a person's actions and judgment?
Why is it dangerous to rely solely on human logic when interpreting the laws of Hashem?
What is the significance of the story of On ben Pelet's wife?
How should one approach difficult life decisions according to the Torah?
What is the difference between Hukim and other types of laws?
